info.name: Serif Health Pricing Distributions Rates API
Get negotiated rates for a procedure code

params.name: code
params.description: The procedure code (CPT or DRG) to look up.

params.name: region
params.description: US state abbreviation to scope rates to (e.g. PA).

params.name: tier
params.description: Service tier, e.g. professional or facility.

params.name: site
params.description: Site of service, e.g. nonfac (non-facility) or fac (facility).

params.name: payer
params.description: Payer name to filter to (e.g. bcbs, cigna, uhc).

items.docs: Returns payer-negotiated reimbursement rates for a single procedure code (CPT/DRG), optionally filtered by region, tier, site of service, and payer.
